div.div:
Notes
*1 Containers have no file mount
The app calls the S3 SDK with the access point alias or ARN. Fargate cannot use FSx for ONTAP through a volume mount.
*2 VPC origin refuses requests from outside the VPC
Services such as Amazon Athena and Amazon Bedrock need Internet origin (Figures 2 and 3). The origin cannot be changed after creation.
*3 NFS / SMB clients are unchanged
Attaching an access point does not change how the volume behaves over NFS or SMB.
